design.title: Same eyes, more worldly upbringing, actually trained: each member's EfficientNet-B0 trunk starts from Noisy Student weights instead of plain ImageNet weights (re-run of experiment 24, which never reached a GPU)
design.init_strategy: pretrained:tf_efficientnet_b0.ns_jft_in1k (Noisy Student, Apache-2.0, ported into torchvision's EfficientNet-B0 layout with TF-same padding)
design.eli5: The drone's 'eyes' are a pair of image-recognition networks that learn from a large collection of everyday photos before they learn Berlin. Each time we gave them better early training, they got much better at recognising Berlin in a photograph they had never seen. The chip has no room for bigger eyes, so we keep exactly the same eyes but swap in a version first trained on 300 million photos, many of them deliberately blurred, noisy or with altered colours. We already tried this once, but the cloud computer never started, so the idea was never actually tested.
design.hypothesis: Experiment 24's hypothesis was never tested. Its run died before training: AWS had no g6.xlarge capacity in any eu-central-1 zone (spot or on-demand; train_berlin.log ends 'no capacity for g6.xlarge anywhere in the region'), so the scorer recorded 1e9 and the harness marked it REVERTED. That verdict says nothing about Noisy Student weights, just as experiment 17's crash said nothing about ring pooling (re-run as 18). The same is true of experiment 21 (LP-FT, AWS endpoint connection error). The reasoning stands unchanged on the current champion (exp 20, mission 0.0777: usable 93.0%, false 0.75%, abstain 6.25% on held-out truedop_2024; the three training photographs at 100% usable at the same viewpoints). Every large step on the never-seen photograph in this era came from what the trunk brought with it: from-scratch -> MobileNetV3-Small 10.75% -> 49.5% usable (exp 12), MobileNetV2 86.75% (exp 16), EfficientNet-B0 92.5% (exp 19). Since then, changes to the training procedure have given at most half a point (exp 20 weight averaging, kept) or lost ground (exp 22 continuous vantages 0.103, exp 23 cross-survey JS consistency 0.090). Bigger trunks are ruled out by the size gate (two B0 members = 31.7 MB of 33.6 MB), so this changes the trunk's KNOWLEDGE and keeps its SIZE: same EfficientNet-B0, initialised from the Noisy Student checkpoint (Xie et al. 2020; ImageNet + 300M pseudo-labelled JFT images under RandAugment, dropout and stochastic depth). Its headline result is out-of-distribution robustness (ImageNet-C/-P/-A: blur, noise, brightness, contrast, weather), and that is the photometric half of a survey change. No experiment in any era has varied the pretraining SOURCE of a fixed architecture. Builds on experiment 20 (champion) and is otherwise identical to experiment 24's pre-registered design, whose code survives in runs/20261102_104104_experiment24/model_src/.
